name: Dialogue Colors
author: DJLegends
description: Gives each speaker's quotes and *thoughts* a colour or gradient of their own, worked out on your device from the text the chat shows: who said each line is guessed from speech tags, action beats and turn-taking, and you can correct any line. Nothing is written into your messages and nothing is sent to a model. A port of the Local DOM engine of platberlitz's Dialogue Colors for SillyTavern.
